paragraphs.text: We evaluate BERT on SST-2 as well, and report F1 scores across datasets.
A graph neural network baseline is used for the retrieval task on MS MARCO.
However, the graph neural network does not improve F1 on MS MARCO in our replication.
We compare BERT with the graph neural network baseline under the same tokenizer.
Our ablation confirms that BERT benefits from contrastive learning on SST-2.
The annotated corpus is released with sentence-level classification labels.
